nav.homeDescription: Four areas. Everything for your next race day.

areaDescriptions.race: Start, organize and control races live.
areaDescriptions.garage: Prepare cars, drivers, teams and tracks.
areaDescriptions.analysis: Explore lap times, results and records.

fuelRules.title: Fuel, fuel weight & required stops
fuelRules.description: Set virtual consumption, scoring factor and minimum pit stops.
fuelRules.requires: Select a track and session; edit rules before starting.

driverStrategy.title: Personal driver link & pit strategy
driverStrategy.description: Driver controls for starting fuel, tyres, refill target and estimated range.
driverStrategy.requires: Director credential and assigned driver; issue the personal link here.

penalties.title: Time penalties & serving
penalties.description: Issue, revoke or confirm a served penalty with evidence.
penalties.requires: Director credential and a started race required.

recovery.title: Resolve abandoned sessions
recovery.description: Inspect and explicitly resolve orphaned running sessions.
recovery.requires: Director credential; the currently bound session stays protected.

directorAccess.title: Recover director access
directorAccess.description: Reset a forgotten director credential through the interface.
directorAccess.requires: Open via localhost on the race PC, then sign in again.

soundAutomation.title: Sound library & automatic triggers
soundAutomation.description: Manage clips or speech and connect them to race events.
soundAutomation.requires: Load or create sounds; remote playback needs an enabled receiver.

voice.title: Race commentary & voice
voice.description: Configure start, lead change, finish, best-lap and podium speech.
voice.requires: Browser speech must be available and permitted.

ambience.title: Local race ambience
ambience.description: Motor ambience with volume, mute and speech ducking.
ambience.requires: Select track and session; start playback by clicking on this device.

fuelHistory.title: Fuel history & simulated laps
fuelHistory.description: Compare measured times, fuel levels and virtual weight effects.
fuelHistory.requires: Open a stored session with virtual fuel; measured data stays intact.

startDiagnostics.title: Start diagnostics & log
startDiagnostics.description: Record and download start lights, status changes and audio scheduling.
startDiagnostics.requires: Enable diagnostics before the start; download the log after the attempt. Download the log via localhost on the race PC. Remote requests require director authorization on the server.
